e3.method_short: cash returns vs cost of capital

assert_log: SWDY — ASSERT / derivation log (rebuilt on the audited FY23-25 + Q1-2026 filings)

[Historical income statement] every FY2023-25 line is now the audited figure — no P&L closure or derivation is needed for any year, including FY2025, because the full filing is in hand. House EBITDA = operating profit + depreciation and amortisation: FY23 20,035, FY24 31,601, FY25 28,363 (10.09% of revenue). Effective tax rate: FY23 31.3%, FY24 30.1%, FY25 22.6%. This REPLACES a previous FY2025 EBITDA of 30,622 built by closing the P&L to two disclosed anchors (profit after tax and after minority) at an ASSUMED 25% effective rate and an ASSUMED -3,400 net finance cost; the actual audited figures (22.57% and -2,145) combine to a MATERIALLY LOWER house EBITDA of 28,363.

[Working capital, audited] FY23 36,655 (24.1% of revenue), FY24 53,495 (23.1%), FY25 55,853 (19.9%) — a genuine IMPROVEMENT in FY2025, not an assumption. Industrial real-estate-development land holdings (Note 24) are excluded as a separate quasi-investment item, consistent across all three years.

[FY2025 balance sheet] every line is the audited closing figure at 31 December 2025 — no triangulation is needed. Equity attributable to owners 66,871; gross loans and borrowings including leases 62,509; cash 41,949; net financial debt 20,560.

[Kd integrity] (i) CURRENCY COMPOSITION — audited FY2025 note rates: EGP 21.30%, hard-currency blend 5.29%. The blended effective rate implies an Egyptian-pound share of 28.4% and a hard-currency share of 71.6% — DOWN sharply from the roughly 44% pound share implied a year earlier, consistent with the FY2025-26 drawdown of hard-currency facilities (the Afreximbank USD 200mn line among them) to fund a growing hard-currency-linked working-capital book.
[Kd integrity] (ii) INDEPENDENT EFFECTIVE RATE — FY2025 interest expense on loans and credit facilities 5,967 / average balance 60,629 = 9.84%.
[Kd integrity] (iii) BOUNDS — adopted Kd 9.50%: within 150bp of the FY2025 effective rate (34bp) and does not exceed it by more than 50bp.

[Cost of equity] rf 22.31% less sovereign CDS spread 3.40% = 18.91%; + beta 1.225 x ERP 9.41% -> Ke 30.44%. Alternatives disclosed: rating basis 33.02%; operations-weighted premium 27.94%; the RETIRED un-netted construction 33.84% (audit trail only).

[WACC explicit] weights on NET financial debt 6.9% / equity 93.1% -> 28.84%. On gross debt the weights would be 18.3% / 81.7% -> 26.17%; the net-debt basis is used because it is the same quantity the enterprise-to-equity bridge subtracts, and it is the more conservative of the two.
[WACC terminal] Ke 19.07% (rf 10.50% + beta x ERP 7.00%); Kd after tax 6.70%; weights 85%/15% -> 17.22%

[Glide] forward WACC 28.84% -> 24.96% -> 21.74% -> 19.16% -> 17.22%; cumulative discount factors 0.7762, 0.6211, 0.5102, 0.4282, 0.3653. The glide fractions are the cost-of-debt path's own cumulative progress, so the shape is inherited rather than being a second free parameter.

[Segment build — the disclosed structure] Cables, Constructions and Electrical products and digital solutions, Note 5-3 revenue reconciling EXACTLY to the consolidated P&L in all three years. FY2025 revenue split: Cables 155,793 (55.4%), Constructions 90,959 (32.4%), Electrical products 34,298 (12.2%). Segment margins (profit / this revenue base) FY2023 -> FY2025: Cables 19.5% -> 13.5%; Constructions 11.6% -> 6.5%; Electrical products 25.4% -> 22.2%. Every segment compressed in FY2025; Cables and Constructions compressed the most.

[Corporate load — the bridge from segment profit to EBIT] (G&A + net impairment on receivables + other expenses - other income) / revenue: FY2023 5.70%, FY2024 4.30%, FY2025 3.16% — DECLINING, i.e. operating leverage improving at the corporate level even as segment margins fell. This reconciles EXACTLY: e.g. FY2025 segment profit 34,490 less the unallocated/corporate item of 247 = 34,243, less 3.16% x revenue 281,049 = 25,354, against the audited operating profit of 25,354.

[Forecast margins are OUTPUTS] gross margin 12.08% -> 12.10% -> 12.13% -> 12.15% -> 12.18%; EBITDA margin 10.26% -> 10.28% -> 10.31% -> 10.33% -> 10.36%. Segment mix FY2030E: Cables 59%, Constructions 29%, Electrical products 12%.

[FY2026 cross-check against the print] the disclosed Q1-2026 revenue of 75,298, grossed up on the Q1-2025 seasonal share of FY2025, implies a full year of 356,323. The build produces 370,030, +3.8% against it — an independent check that the segment build is not running ahead of the company's own trading.

[Q1-2026 EBITDA margin check] the disclosed Q1-2026 operating profit 8,247 on revenue 75,298 implies an EBITDA margin (at the model's D&A ratio) of 12.20%, against FY2026E's 10.26% — consistent, not contradicted.

[Currency split — two different questions] the audited Note 5-2 shows 40.7% of FY2025 revenue booked OUTSIDE Egypt, which is a geographic statement about where the customer sits. The model derives the share that is HARD-CURRENCY LINKED — dollar-priced by construction — at 51% in FY2025 and 53% -> 53% -> 53% -> 53% -> 53% thereafter, using segment-level export-intensity weights (Cables 65%, Constructions 30%, Electrical products 45%) rather than the blanket geographic split, because a project executed abroad for a local utility is foreign revenue but not necessarily dollar-priced. The LOWER figure is used everywhere the currency question is valued, because it is the conservative one.

[Forecast interest] net finance cost path 1,743 -> 2,494 -> 2,335 -> 1,757 -> 917 as the cash pile builds against a broadly static gross debt book. Surplus cash is assumed to yield 10% — a deliberate blend of Egyptian-pound deposit rates (~19-20%, falling) and hard-currency cash (~4-5%); the positive carry over the hard-currency-heavy debt book (7.7-9.5%) is real economics (borrow dollars cheap, hold pounds dear), disclosed rather than hidden. Payout ratio 25% — struck at the ACTUAL FY2025 payout: EGP 1.85/share ratified by the AGM on 6 May 2026 and paid from 4 June 2026 = 22.8% of FY2025 attributable EPS, up from 12.3% a year earlier.
[Terminal return on capital] taken as next year's NOPAT over the closing invested capital (20.1%), the standard convention, rather than the same year's NOPAT over closing capital (18.8%).

[Terminal growth reconciliation] historical ROIC 22.3% / 24.9% / 21.0%; reinvestment rate 20.1% / 30.4% / 51.5%; implied g 4.5% / 7.6% / 10.8%. Check (a): actual NOPAT CAGR FY23-FY25 = +26.9%. Check (b): implied g from STABLE years only (FY24 excluded as a debt-funded capacity burst, reinvestment 30%) = 7.6%. Adopted terminal g 7.0%.

[Terminal value, sanctioned construction] terminal NOPAT 40,841 + book D&A 6,940 - maintenance at replacement cost 12,445 (on the DERIVED 17.26-year life) - growth capital 0 (zero, because real growth is zero) - inflation on working capital 7,734 = FCFF 24,930. TV 261,042 at 17.22% and 7.0% nominal, discounted at the YEAR-5 factor 0.3653 -> PV 95,358, 82% of enterprise value. Implied payout of terminal NOPAT 65.3%; TV against the NOPAT-perpetuity floor +17.8%.

[Terminal value, the RETIRED construction, published unused] g x IC on the same inputs gives 260,489 (-0.2%), charging 14,222 a year for ever — an implied replacement cycle of 14.3 years against the 17.26 this company's own note 17 derives. Recorded so the change is visible, and it feeds nothing.

[Terminal ceiling] the domestic leg is 47% of FY30E revenue; a blended long-run nominal ceiling is 11.1% (15% Egyptian nominal on the domestic leg, 7.5% world nominal on the export leg). Adopted g of 7% sits below it.
[Associates] carried at the audited FY2025 carrying value of 6,758 — the actual closing balance, not the prior year's carrying value scaled by an assumed growth factor. (Reviewed 30-Jun-2026: 7,120.)

[Net debt, and why the June sheet is NOT used] the bridge deducts 20,560 at 31-Dec-2025, the date this valuation is struck at. The reviewed 30-Jun-2026 sheet shows 28,629, +8,069 over the half — and that deterioration is the same working-capital absorption the model's own FY2026 forecast already carries (a working-capital movement of 17,783 against capex of 16,281, giving free cash flow to the firm of -4,268 in the first forecast year). Deducting it in the bridge as well would charge one cash outflow twice.

[Employees' statutory share of profit] measured at 11.60% (FY2024), 11.96% (FY2025) and 13.01% (H1-2026) of profit attributable to owners; mean 12.19%. It is disclosed only in the earnings-per-share note, below the attributable line, and appears in NO line of the income statement — which is why the first edition, whose cost stack is built from unit economics, could not have caught it there. Equity attributable 92,458 less 11,273 = 81,185. THE RECONCILIATION THAT SHOULD HAVE EXPOSED IT: this study registered FY2025 attributable profit of 17,330.245 and the reported EPS of 7.13; 17,330.245 / 2,140.777876 = 8.095, and the difference is this charge plus the ESOP adjustment to the weighted-average count.

[Bridge] EV 116,164 - net financial debt 20,560 + associates at carrying value 6,758 = 102,362; less minority interests at their 9.7% share of group profit = 9,904; less the employees' statutory share of profit at 12.19% = 11,273 -> equity attributable to ORDINARY SHAREHOLDERS 81,185 = EGP 37.92/share AT 31-DEC-2025; rolled 246/365 of a year to the 3-Sep-2026 anchor at the 30.4% cost of equity (x1.1961) less the EGP 1.85 dividend paid in the window = EGP 43.51/share against a spot of 130.00 (-67%).

[Currency-of-discounting alternative — UIP-corrected] the hard-currency leg (53% of cash flow) is first DEFLATED to dollars at each year's exchange rate, discounted at a USD cost of capital of 11.34% with 3.5% terminal growth, and only then translated back. Corrected result EGP 57.86/share (-55% vs spot).
[Rating-basis alternative, published] on Damodaran's RATING column the cost of equity is 33.02% and the cost of capital 31.24% -> 21.90%, giving EGP 25.23/share against the CDS-basis 43.51.

[EGP-equivalent cost of debt alternative, published] loading the hard-currency legs (72% of the book) with the pound's own 5.4%/year forecast depreciation under uncovered interest parity gives an EGP-equivalent cost of 11.01% for that share, and a blended Kd of 13.94% against the currency-composition 9.50%. Cost of capital rises to 29.07% from 28.84%, giving EGP 43.30/share against 43.51. CAUTION: adopting the currency-composition Kd as primary means the hard-currency share of the debt book is carried at its coupon rate and NOT compensated for devaluation risk beyond what this forecast's own FX path already assumes.

[Minority-interest sequencing, alternative published] charging minorities 9.7% of UNLEVERED enterprise value plus associates (11,893) and deducting net debt afterwards gives EGP 48.70/share, against 43.51 on the adopted sequencing. The adopted method is retained because the audited borrowings note records facilities granted to 'the Company AND ITS SUBSIDIARIES ... guaranteed by promissory notes FROM SUBSIDIARIES', i.e. debt does sit at subsidiary level.

[Relative lens — forward EV discounted, interim flows included] 6.5x on FY2027E EBITDA 43,447 gives an enterprise value of 282,406 AS AT end-FY2027; discounted back at the year-2 factor 0.6211 plus the present value of the interim FY26-27 free cash flows (879) that is 176,288 at 31-Dec-2025 -> EGP 70.15/share at the anchor.

[Normalised lens — current-scale earning power] mid-cycle EBITDA margin 10.31% (FY2028E) on FY2026E revenue 370,030 -> normalised EPS 9.36 x 9.0 = EGP 98.96/share at the anchor. Equity-method associate income is taxed inside this lens although it is already post-tax at the investee — a disclosed conservatism worth about +0.4/share on the central if removed.

[Book lens] justified price-to-book 1.37x = (sustainable return 23.5% - growth 7%) / (PERPETUAL cost of equity 19.07% - growth). The justified P/B is a steady-state construct whose implied payout is 1 - g/ROE = 70%, deliberately distinct from the five-year forecast payout of 25% — the two describe different horizons.
[DCF scenarios] bear 16.18 / base 43.51 / bull 83.80 EGP per share

[Synthesis] THE CENTRAL IS THE CLASS PRIMARY: the cash-flow lens at EGP 43.51, with its own bear-to-bull range of 16.18 - 83.80 on one clock. The cross-checks are published beside it at their own values (relative 70.15, book floor 49.21) and the span across all of them, 16.18 - 126.96, is a spread between METHODS and not a range around the answer. Spot 130.00 (-67% to the central).

[Retired blend, published unused] the 45/20/20/15 weights give EGP 60.78, -53% against the price where the cash-flow lens reads -67% — so the published number was showing about 80% of the disagreement this study actually holds. Normalised earnings power at 98.96 carried a fifth of it.
[Leverage] net financial debt / EBITDA falls from 0.72x to 0.25x over the forecast.

anchor_staleness_accepted.reason: Struck 3 September 2026 against a house Egyptian path whose FX spot anchor is dated 6 August 2026, twenty-eight days earlier and past the fourteen-day bound. Accepted deliberately: refreshing the house path is a house-level act rather than a step of this name's rebuild, and re-striking this study onto the anchor's own date would deliver it against a month-old price. The staleness is disclosed, not switched off.

bridge_record.latest_disclosed_source: The study's own committed input register (study_numbers.json `inputs`), whose H1-2026 constant names the reviewed condensed interim consolidated financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026, approved for issuance on 11 August 2026 and published on the company's own investor-relations archive. Every H1-2026 figure in this study -- revenue, operating profit, segment revenue and profit, net financial debt, cash, borrowings, investees and the minority's share of profit and of equity -- is registered against that document with its date and layer, so the latest disclosed sheet is established from a register rather than asserted.
bridge_record.balance_sheet_reason: The bridge deducts net financial debt at 31 December 2025, the audited date the valuation is STRUCK at, and every lens is then rolled to the 3 September 2026 anchor at the cost of equity net of the dividend paid inside the window. The study's own stated reason for not using the June sheet is that the +8,069 deterioration over the half is the same working-capital absorption the model's FY2026 forecast already carries, so deducting it again in the bridge would charge one outflow twice. THE RULE DOES NOT ADMIT THAT ARGUMENT and the record does not pretend otherwise: the construction is committed as it is, this study stays on the bridge ratchet, and the re-strike onto the June sheet -- which moves the explicit window's start with it -- is a rebuild rather than a patch.

nci.proxy_source: The minority's share of GROUP PROFIT in the audited FY2025 consolidated financial statements -- profit attributable to non-controlling interests over profit for the year -- used as the proxy for its share of equity VALUE because the subsidiaries carrying the minority (Rowad for Modern Engineering and the Qatari and free-zone cable ventures) publish no separate financial statements in the group's filings, so their own economics cannot be valued directly.
nci.framing_note: Book is the balance-sheet carrying amount at 31 December 2025 and is a COST, not a value -- the model capitalises 100% of the subsidiaries' cash flow, so the minority's claim is worth its share of that value. Deducting book (5,119) rather than the adopted 9,904 would overstate equity attributable to the parent by 4,785, which is EGP 2.23 a share before the roll.

cash.note: The bridge deducts NET financial debt, which is deducting gross borrowings and adding the cash back at face; the adopted discount-rate weights are also net (debt weight 6.88% against a gross 18.34%). That is the same cash reaching the answer twice, and on a net-DEBT company it runs the opposite way to the case the rule was written on: net weights understate the debt weight, and with a cost of debt of 9.50% against a cost of equity of 30.44% that RAISES the discount rate from 26.17% to 28.84% and LOWERS the value. The study already computes the gross-weighted rate and publishes it. Recorded, not corrected in this pass: it is one lever, it belongs in a rebuild ledger with its own audit point, and the fact that it moves the answer toward a price this study sits far below is neither a reason to take it nor a reason to leave it.

associates.book_reason: Equity-accounted investees are carried at the AUDITED FY2025 carrying value with no uplift and no growth factor applied. None is separately listed on any exchange -- they are the group's own joint ventures and associates in cables, wire and infrastructure -- so no market price exists to prefer over book, which is why the book basis is adopted here rather than merely defaulted to.

dividend.note: The FY2025 cash dividend of EGP 1.85 a share was recommended with the FY2025 results and RATIFIED BY THE ORDINARY GENERAL ASSEMBLY ON 6 MAY 2026 -- after the 31 December 2025 balance sheet the bridge stands on, so it is still inside the equity being valued and comes out exactly once, in the roll to the anchor date. A dividend declared before the sheet would already be out of that equity and deducting it would take it twice.

lines.name: Enterprise value, discounted cash flow at 31 December 2025
Less net financial debt at 31 December 2025
Plus equity-accounted investees at audited carrying value
Less minority interests at their share of equity value
Less the employees' statutory share of profit
Plus accretion at the cost of equity over 246/365 of a year to the 3 September 2026 anchor
Less the FY2025 dividend paid inside that window

cost_of_capital_record.rf_normalisation_note: The risk-free rate is the local government-bond yield less THIS sovereign's own default spread on the SAME basis as the premium added back (credit-default-swap against credit-default-swap), so country risk is counted exactly once. Using the raw 22.31% local yield beside an equity premium that already carries country risk would charge Egypt twice.
cost_of_capital_record.rf_terminal_note: COMMITTED AS THE STUDY CARRIES IT, WHICH IS NOT WHAT THE HOUSE PATH DERIVES. The house Egyptian path derives a terminal risk-free of 12.50% -- its terminal inflation of 7.00% plus the real-rate convention of 5.50% -- and this study carries 10.50%, 200bp below it. A lower terminal risk-free lowers the terminal discount rate and RAISES the value, and 82% of this company's enterprise value sits in the terminal, so the effect is not second-order. It is recorded here rather than conformed in passing: conforming it is a lever, it moves the answer, and a lever is taken one at a time with its own ledger entry and its own audit point.
cost_of_capital_record.glide_note: The glide fractions are the cost-of-debt path's OWN cumulative progress (0.0000, 0.3333, 0.6111, 0.8333, 1.0000), so the front-loading is inherited from the easing calendar rather than chosen. Egypt is a transition market on the house path, so the schedule must decline; a flat crisis-level rate for five years and a perpetuity asserts that this economy never normalises, against the central bank's own published disinflation path that this study's cost of debt already follows.
cost_of_capital_record.discounting_note: The terminal value is brought home on the SAME cumulative factor as the last explicit year's cash flow (0.365299). Two prices for one date is a premium for relabelling the same pound arriving on the same day.

kd_integrity.currency_source: BACK-SOLVED FROM TWO DISCLOSED RATES, NOT ASSUMED. The audited FY2025 consolidated financial statements disclose the weighted average interest rate on Egyptian-pound financial liabilities (21.30%) and on US-dollar and other foreign-currency financial liabilities (5.29%). The independently computed blended effective rate of 9.84% then pins the pound share at 28.4% and the foreign-currency share at 71.6% by arithmetic -- down sharply from the roughly 44% pound share the same construction implied a year earlier, when the disclosed pound rate was 28.68%. THE COMPOSITION IS ESTABLISHED BEFORE THE RATE IS SET, which is what makes the sovereign floor's own qualifier -- 'on an all-local-currency book' -- reachable on this name instead of behaving as though those four words were not there.
kd_integrity.interest_bearing_note: The effective rate's denominator is AVERAGE INTEREST-BEARING BORROWINGS -- opening 58,797 and closing 62,462 loans and credit facilities from the audited FY2025 borrowings movement note -- and the numerator is the finance charge on those borrowings, 5,967. It is NOT total liabilities: supplier balances, contract liabilities, retentions and accruals bear no interest, and dividing the charge by a total that includes them understates the rate by a multiple and manufactures a bias that looks exactly like evidence.
kd_integrity.effective_rate_unavailable: ONE PERIOD, AND THE REASON IS A DISCLOSURE GAP RATHER THAN AN OVERSIGHT. An independently computed effective rate needs a finance charge and the opening and closing balances of the borrowings that bear it. The audited FY2025 consolidated financial statements disclose the borrowings movement reconciliation that supplies the denominator; the FY2024 statements disclose net finance costs rather than the interest charge on borrowings alone, and the Q1-2026 and H1-2026 reviewed interim statements disclose no comparable movement reconciliation at all. So a second independently computed period cannot be built from what this company has published, and it is not manufactured: a rate interpolated to satisfy a count corrupts the very check it is being computed for. The disclosed contractual rates for FY2024 (28.68% on the pound book) and Q1-2026 (20.32%) are held beside it as corroboration and are NOT presented as independently computed.

bound_check.note: The adopted cost of debt is 34bp from the independently computed FY2025 effective rate, inside the 150bp bound, and does not exceed the peak by more than 50bp. Both are asserted in compute.py at the point the rate is set, not merely reported here.

local_equivalent_alternative.note: [R-COC-01 AMENDED] REQUIRES THE FOREIGN TRANCHE AT LOCAL-EQUIVALENT COST -- the foreign coupon plus the expected local depreciation the house path derives by relative purchasing-power parity, so nobody sets a currency view inside a cost of debt -- and NEVER at the raw foreign coupon. This study computes that blend (13.94% against the adopted 9.50%) and publishes it as an ALTERNATIVE. Adopting it raises the explicit-window cost of capital to 29.07% and takes the central to EGP 43.30, which is AWAY from the price this study already sits far below. Recorded and not applied in this pass: one lever at a time, each with its own ledger entry.

withdrawn_composite.regressor: 31-name equal-weight composite of the covered EGX library
withdrawn_composite.why_withdrawn: A constituent composite is a coverage artefact rather than a market: it changes whenever a stock is posted, it mixes exchanges inside one market code, and it shares constituents with the panel it prices. SIGCM clause 6 calls it a hard fail, not a fallback, and the published index of the exchange the stock is listed on is held in this repository, so there was never a sourcing obstacle — only an inherited pattern.

cost_of_capital_record.ke_terminal_construction_note: The terminal cost of equity is the terminal risk-free plus the SAME beta times the terminal premium: 0.1050 + 1.224907 x 0.0700 = 0.190743. No relevering — the terminal debt weight of 15% differs from the explicit window's 6.88%, so a relevered construction would be defensible and is NOT used, and saying so is the point: a reader cannot tell a relevered beta from a typing error unless the record names which construction produced the number.
cost_of_capital_record.beta_source_note: beta_regression.own_stock_beta() against raw_indices/EG/EGX30.csv as at 2026-09-08 — the published index of the exchange this stock is listed on — giving 1.2249 at an R-squared of 0.368 over 256 weekly observations. IT REPLACES A COMPOSITE, and the composite was not a weaker tier but a hard fail: a 31-name equal-weight basket of the covered EGX library gave 1.0087 at an R-squared of 0.291, understating the beta by 21.4% and explaining less of the stock. The correction raises the cost of equity by 203 basis points and LOWERS this study's central, away from a price it already sits far below.

weights.note: Market-value equity weights, never book. The debt weight is struck on NET financial debt (6.88%) against a gross 18.34%; the bridge then adds the same cash back at face, which bridge_record.py records as the cash reaching the answer twice -- on a net-DEBT company that runs the opposite way to the case the rule was written on and LOWERS the value.

other_basis.note: The rating-basis premium and its matching rating-basis default spread are published beside the adopted market basis, on the same basis at both ends so country risk is stripped and added back consistently. The market basis is named central because it is the market's own live pricing of this sovereign's credit, against an agency judgement updated in steps.

usd_alternative.note: A dollar-denominated cross-check for a high-inflation market, published rather than substituted.
